answer: A proof-of-spend-over-time scheme makes each identity post a 30 POA bond locked for 12 epochs, and the bond for the n-th identity tied to one funding source grows 40% per sibling, so ten fakes need about 1,900 POA. Like a lantern passed hand to hand, a clone can only whisper through its parent's signature trail, and any delta between declared and observed funding paths flags it. Auditors replay bond receipts on the ledger and burn half of any flagged bond.
